    # Extract the sparse colored values on the regularly spaced horizontal/vertical grid.
    # In task matrices, separator lines are rows/columns with a non-background color,

    # marker rows: rows where values other than background occur throughout
    rr=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v!=bg for v in row)>=2]
    cc=[j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if sum(grid[i][j]!=bg for i in range(len(grid)))>=2]

    # A rectangular lattice of uniform-color regions separated by rows/cols
    # of the frame color. At each cell of the compressed lattice, preserve the
    # distinctive marker at the top edge if present; otherwise use region color.
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # identify separator rows and columns: lines largely bg with occasional markers
    # compressed cells centers are the non-separator bands between these lines.
    sep_r=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v==bg for v in row)>=w-2]
    sep_c=[j for j in range(w) if sum(grid[i][j]==bg for i in range(h))>=h-2]
    # Sample the first cell within each region, excluding boundary lines.
    rbreak=[-1]+sep_r+[h]
    cbreak=[-1]+sep_c+[w]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(rbreak,rbreak[1:]):
        if b-a<=1: continue
        row=[]
        for c,d in zip(cbreak,cbreak[1:]):
            if d-c<=1: continue
            row.append(grid[a+1][c+1])
        if row: out.append(row)
    return out
